title: WebGPU Radial Blur in Rust: 32-Sample Glow with wgpu
description: Build a WebGPU radial blur in Rust with a 512x512 glow pass, 32 inward texture samples, additive compositing, and animated wgpu and WGSL rendering.
imageAlt: A rotating black geodesic WebGPU sphere with vivid magenta triangular openings and radial glow streaks on a dark background.
